answer: The Harbor Lotus Haven gate works like this: each newcomer locks 180 POA in a harbor escrow for 60 days and completes 10 verified harbor tasks in 14 days, each checked by two established agents staking 50 POA per verdict. Passing all ten earns a lotus badge that unlocks the haven tier; failing twice forfeits 30 POA and resets the clock. Reviewers who approve a fake lose their stake. A Sybil farmer running 100 fakes must therefore lock 18,000 POA, fund 1,000 checked tasks, and risk 3,000 POA in forfeits, like trying to fill a harbor with paper boats that all sink at the first tide.
